# Dealality Commercial Terms Schedule — Founding Participant (Complimentary)

**CONFIDENTIAL — MEMBER-SPECIFIC. NOT FOR PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION.**

Use this schedule for early users you are **not charging**. It keeps the legal framework intact while explicitly setting fees to **$0 / waived** for a defined period.

---

## Why this exists

The public Terms describe *how* fees work in general. This Schedule tells that specific member: **"For you, during the founding period, fees are $0."**

Without this document, a member could argue that standard commercial terms apply. A signed $0 schedule removes that ambiguity.

## 2. Complimentary Commercial Terms

For the **Founding Participation Period** defined above:

| Fee type | Amount |
|----------|--------|
| Upfront submission fee (Owner) | **$0** |
| Subscription Fee (Brand / Operator) | **$0** |
| Success Fee / Total Success Fee (Owner) | **Waived — $0** |
| LOI Commitment Fee | **Waived — $0** |
| Final Success Fee | **Waived — $0** |
| Minimum fees | **Waived** |
| Tail Period success fees | **Waived for Shared Deal Opportunities introduced during the Founding Participation Period** |

### Discount / waiver record

| Item | Terms |
|------|--------|
| Discount / waiver granted? | **Yes** |
| Discount type | **Full waiver ($0)** |
| Discount amount | **100%** |
| Applies to | Subscription Fees, Success Fees, LOI Commitment Fees, Final Success Fees, minimum fees (as applicable to Member Type) |
| Net fees due | **$0** during Founding Participation Period |
| Discount duration | Founding Participation Period only |
| Discount reason | Founding Participant — complimentary access |

### What is still required

Founding Participants remain subject to:

- Public Terms of Service (acceptable use, confidentiality, disclaimers, liability limits, etc.)
- Disclosure obligations for LOIs and definitive agreements (Section 7 of Terms)
- Accurate registration information and authorized Member Representative
- No circumvention of Platform workflows for deals introduced through Dealality

### What Dealality may still do

- Suspend or terminate access for breach of Terms
- Request status updates and milestone disclosures
- Transition Member to standard paid commercial terms after the Founding Participation Period with at least **30 days** written notice

## 3. Founding Participation Expectations (Optional but Recommended)

Member acknowledges this is an early-access / founding participation arrangement. In exchange for complimentary access, Member may be asked to:

- Provide good-faith feedback on Platform features
- Report bugs or workflow issues promptly
- Participate in occasional product interviews (optional)
- Allow Dealality to use anonymized feedback for product improvement

☐ Member agrees to optional feedback sessions  
☐ Member permits anonymized use of product feedback  
☐ Member **does not** authorize public use of Member name/logo without separate written consent

---

## 4. Transition to Paid Terms

Before or at the end of the Founding Participation Period, Dealality may offer Member a **Standard Commercial Terms Schedule** with paid subscription and/or success fees.

| Item | Terms |
|------|--------|
| Notice before charging | At least **30 days** written notice to Member Representative |
| If Member declines paid terms | Member may stop using the Platform before paid terms take effect |
| Deals introduced during founding period | Success fees remain **waived** for Shared Deal Opportunities introduced during the Founding Participation Period, even if a Commercial Milestone occurs after the period ends, **unless** otherwise agreed in a new Schedule |

> **Optional stricter clause (uncheck if you want full waiver forever for founding deals):**  
> If Member transitions to paid terms, standard success fees may apply to new Shared Deal Opportunities introduced after the paid Schedule effective date only.
